groundTruth.rootCause: The cart service fails 25% of EmptyCart requests, so checkout's PlaceOrder calls fail.

hypothesis: A feature flag such as cartFailure may have made cart's EmptyCart use a bad Redis connection. I consider this less likely: later EmptyCart calls (for example 17:15:08 and 17:16:11) went through without errors, while a flag that is on would make every one fail. I could not read flag state to rule it out.
